title: Kusanagi Nene — To Become The Canary〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Good morning, Kusanagi. You're here bright and early!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Morning, Kusanagi! Are you also here to get in some solo practice?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I am. Also, I was wondering...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Could I join you for stretches?

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Certainly, be our guest! By the way, how is practice going? We don't have any scenes together, but I'm curious to hear about your progress.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...! Also, could I ask later about how things are going with your scenes?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: That concludes our ensemble run-through! Once again, the rest of our time will be for individual practice.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Oh, Kusanagi! We were just about to come over to you.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line: Could we work on our scene together again?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's what I was coming over to ask about, so yes, I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also... I'd like your opinions on something...

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: This was such a productive session, Kusanagi! Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line: You wanted our opinions on your canary, right? I think you're taking the right angle.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: That just leaves the question of how realistic you can go. I'm sure a human and a bird will move differently when cowering...

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line:
But there's more to it than just realism.
That aspect is meaningless if you don't get through to your audience.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: That's true. Some actors even purposefully do things that a real animal wouldn't in order to make their performance more evocative.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see what you mean. I'll consider a wider range of ways to portray the character.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They seemed to like my ideas for my portrayal.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I factor in their advice and keep developing the role...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were watching your practice! It seems your preparations are going well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you were watching? Since when...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. Nene, lately you're all powered up and glowy☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've noticed you approaching the rest of the cast more frequently.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We'll be going on stage together, so it only makes sense to share our opinions and what we have planned for our roles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's natural. However, I think you've become even more proactive these last few days.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Has there been some kind of positive change in you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa, a session with Shiraishi and Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You got to join in on a street performance? That sounds so, so fun♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The anxiety I was feeling before we sang kinda just melted away. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think I learned to push through my worries and just try something.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, don't stare at me like that. It feels really awkward.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More importantly, do you guys wanna practice since we're all together now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that's a good idea! Then let's run through the scene where Rio enters the forest to meet the Phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's jump right in then, if we're all ready?
